response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_temp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_img FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_temp, avg_img, avg_img - AVG(avg_img) OVER () AS img_diff_from_mean FROM per_status
